patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered and constrained, alternating between dark background with light text and light background with dark text to create visual rhythm.
Feature sections consistently use a two-column layout with an image/screenshot on one side and descriptive text with a call to action on the other, often alternating the side of the image.
A strong, dark teal/blue is used as a primary background color for hero and key sections, providing a consistent brand anchor and professional feel.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, maintaining persistent access to key links and contact information.
A prominent 'client showcase' section displays a grid of client logos, reinforcing authority and experience, followed by detailed project examples with product screenshots.

technique_notes: The hero section across pages uses a full-width background video with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability, featuring a large, bold headline and descriptive text.
Content sections are structured with alternating background colors (dark teal and white) to visually separate them, with internal content centered and constrained to a readable width.
The primary call-to-action buttons use a bright, contrasting teal color with subtle rounded corners, making them stand out against both dark and light backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with clear hierarchy, paired with a readable, slightly lighter sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and some image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between main sections and within the hero, but a more standard density for text blocks and feature grids.

standout: The site effectively uses a consistent dark, muted video background in its hero sections across multiple pages, immediately conveying a modern and professional tech aesthetic. This, combined with the clear, product-focused client showcase featuring actual UI screenshots, strongly communicates their expertise and tangible results.
